subject_uz: "Uzbekistan GTL" MChJ Chinoz terminali xodimlari uchun tushlik tashkil etish xizmati (taxminan 13 oy, 23 752 porsiya va 900 ta tadbir porsiyasi)

requirements.summary_uz: So'nggi 3 yil davomida xodimlarga kuniga 3 mahal issiq ovqat bilan ta'minlash tajribasi va tasdiqlovchi shartnoma hamda dalolatnomalar talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Experience in the last 3 years of feeding staff three hot meals a day, proven with contracts and acceptance acts.
requirements.quote: xodimlarga kuniga 3 mahal issiq ovqat (nonushta, tushlik va kechki ovqat) bilan ta’minlash bo‘yicha umumiy ovqatlanish xizmatlarini ko‘rsatish tajribasiga ega bo‘lishi shart

requirements.summary_uz: Tushlik kaloriyasi 1300-1500 kkal bo'lishi kerak; ishtirokchi ikki haftalik menyu taqdim etadi.
requirements.summary_en: Lunch must provide 1300-1500 kcal; the bidder submits a two-week menu.
requirements.quote: Tushlik kaloriya 1300 Kkal dan1500 Kkal gachabo‘lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Muzlatilgan go'sht ishlatilmaydi; go'sht yangi so'yilgan va mutaxassis xulosasiga ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Frozen meat may not be used; meat must be freshly slaughtered and carry a specialist's inspection conclusion.
requirements.quote: Muzlatilgan go‘sht mahsulotlari ishlatilishi mumkin emas.

requirements.summary_uz: Minimal go'sht me'yorlari belgilangan: palovda kamida 70 g, sho'rvada kamida 50 g, mol/qo'y go'shtli taomlarda 80-120 g netto.
requirements.summary_en: Minimum meat norms apply: at least 70 g in plov, 50 g in soup, 80-120 g net in beef or lamb dishes.
requirements.quote: palov taomida go‘sht — kamida 70 gramm netto;

requirements.summary_uz: Tushlik har kuni soat 12:00-14:00 oralig'ida beriladi; xizmat mijozning jihozlangan oshxonasida ko'rsatiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Lunch is served daily between 12:00 and 14:00 in the customer's equipped kitchen.

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat muddati 13 oy (mablag'lar tugagunga qadar), 2026-yil 4-chorakdan boshlanadi; 20 824 + 2 928 = 23 752 tushlik porsiyasi.
requirements.summary_en: Service period is 13 months (until the funds run out), starting in Q4 2026; 20,824 + 2,928 = 23,752 lunch portions.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko‘rsatish davomiyligi: 13 oy (shartnoma majburiyatlari yakunlangunga qadarya’ni

requirements.summary_uz: Mijoz so'rovi bo'yicha korporativ tadbirlar uchun ovqat tashkil etiladi (900 porsiya); so'rov 72 soat oldin beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: On the customer's request, food is arranged for corporate events (900 portions); the request comes 72 hours ahead.
requirements.quote: Mijoz korporativ tadbirlarni ovqatlanish bilan ta’minlash uchun so‘rovni bundayxizmatlar uchun

requirements.summary_uz: Kommunal to'lovlar buyurtmachi tomonidan to'lanadi; ijrochi esa jihozlarni saqlaydi, ta'mirlaydi va yo'qolgan idishlarni almashtiradi.
requirements.summary_en: Utilities are paid by the customer; the contractor maintains and repairs equipment and replaces lost tableware.

requirements.summary_uz: Sifat va muddat buzilishlari uchun jarima qo'llaniladi; sifatsiz mahsulot shartnomani bir tomonlama bekor qilishga olib kelishi mumkin.
requirements.summary_en: Penalties apply for late meals and short portions; unfit products can lead to unilateral termination.
requirements.quote: Ovqat kechikib berilgan har bir holatuchun jarima qo'llaniladi.

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik qism 0%, narx 100%; uchta mezon 1 balldan, o'tish bali 3 (diskvalifikatsiya tizimi): eng past narx berganlar orasidan g'olib aniqlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Technical share 0%, price 100%; three criteria of 1 point each with a pass mark of 3 (pass/fail disqualification), then the lowest price wins.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchining taklifi Texnik topshiriq talablariga muvofiqligi

requirements.summary_uz: Kontragent anketasi (1-son shakl) va talab qilingan hujjatlar taqdim etilishi, tekshiruv natijasi ijobiy bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: A counterparty questionnaire (Form 1) with the required documents must be submitted and the vetting result must be positive.
requirements.quote: Kontragent anketasi shaklini va talab etilgan hujjatlarni taqdim etish

Xarid esa faqat tushlikni qamrab oladi (23 752 porsiya, har biri 51 000 so'm, 1 211 352 000 so'm; tadbirlar bilan jami 1 310 352 000 so'm). flags.explanation_en: Criterion 3 requires proven experience in the last 3 years of providing staff with three meals a day (breakfast, lunch, dinner); without it the bidder scores 0 and is disqualified (pass mark 3 out of 3). The purchase itself covers lunch only (23,752 portions at 51,000 UZS each, 1,211,352,000 UZS; 1,310,352,000 UZS with events). A caterer with extensive lunch-only or two-meal experience could be shut out.

flags.rewrite_en: The bidder has experience in the last 3 years of providing catering services for staff (at least one hot meal a day, at a volume of at least 76 portions per day).

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 3 bo'yicha so'nggi 3 yilda xodimlarga kuniga uch mahal (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat) ovqat berish tajribasi majburiy; tajriba tasdiqlanmasa 0 ball va diskvalifikatsiya (o'tish bali 3 dan 3). Xarid esa faqat tushlikni qamrab oladi (23 752 porsiya, har biri 51 000 so'm, 1 211 352 000 so'm; tadbirlar bilan jami 1 310 352 000 so'm). Faqat tushlik tajribasiga ega yoki ikki mahal ovqat bergan tajribali oshxona ishtirokchi chetlashtirilishi mumkin.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 114 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 4 ta; savdolarning 25% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 5%.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): Criterion 3 requires proven experience in the last 3 years of providing staff with three meals a day (breakfast, lunch, dinner); without it the bidder scores 0 and is disqualified (pass mark 3 out of 3). The purchase itself covers lunch only (23,752 portions at 51,000 UZS each, 1,211,352,000 UZS; 1,310,352,000 UZS with events). A caterer with extensive lunch-only or two-meal experience could be shut out.
In the customer's last 114 deals the median number of bidders was 4; 25% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 5%.

2-son shakl: texnik taklif, texnik topshiriq bilan qiyosiy jadval, o'xshash xizmat tajribasi va ishlatiladigan mahsulotlar jadvali
Oxirgi 3 yil davomida kuniga 3 mahal ovqat bilan ta'minlash tajribasini tasdiqlovchi shartnomalar va qabul qilish-topshirish dalolatnomalari
Ta'sis hujjatlari va litsenziya, sanitariya va sifat hujjatlari, mavjud bo'lsa ISO 9001/22000 sertifikatlari
